scenes.self: My friend scoops a handful of snow, tucks it down the back of my coat, and sprints away behind the parked car before I turn around.
scenes.other: Her friend scoops a handful of snow, tucks it down the back of her coat, and sprints away behind the parked car before she turns around.

scenes.self: My roommate stacks every cushion in the flat into a lopsided fort in the living room and dares me to knock it down while I film.
scenes.other: His roommate stacks every cushion in the flat into a lopsided fort in the living room and dares him to knock it down while he films.

scenes.self: Halfway through Monopoly, my sister slides a hotel onto her property and taps the board twice at me, so I tap back.
scenes.other: Halfway through Monopoly, his sister slides a hotel onto her property and taps the board twice at him, so he taps back.

scenes.self: At the office party, a colleague grabs the microphone, dedicates a boy-band song to me, and pulls me up beside her.
scenes.other: At the office party, a colleague grabs the microphone, dedicates a boy-band song to him, and pulls him up beside her.

scenes.self: At my nephew's birthday, the adults kick off their shoes and bounce on the inflatable castle until it tips sideways under me.
scenes.other: At her nephew's birthday, the adults kick off their shoes and bounce on the inflatable castle until it tips sideways under her.

scenes.self: From behind the hedge, my cousin launches a water balloon that bursts on my shoulder, and she reloads a second one.
scenes.other: From behind the hedge, his cousin launches a water balloon that bursts on his shoulder, and she reloads a second one.

scenes.self: My daughter pushes a sock puppet over the sofa arm and gives it a squeaky voice that argues with everything I say.
scenes.other: Her daughter pushes a sock puppet over the sofa arm and gives it a squeaky voice that argues with everything she says.

scenes.self: At the playground, a kid taps my elbow, shouts that I am it, and weaves between the swings while I chase.
scenes.other: At the playground, a kid taps her elbow, shouts that she is it, and weaves between the swings while she chases.

scenes.self: While we roll dough, my friend flicks a pinch of flour at my nose and hides the bag behind her back.
scenes.other: While they roll dough, her friend flicks a pinch of flour at her nose and hides the bag behind her back.

scenes.self: My date feeds coins into the claw machine, misses three times, then bangs the glass and challenges me to beat that.
scenes.other: His date feeds coins into the claw machine, misses three times, then bangs the glass and challenges him to beat that.

scenes.self: My puppy grabs my sock, bolts down the hallway, and stops just out of reach, waiting for me to lunge.
scenes.other: Her puppy grabs her sock, bolts down the hallway, and stops just out of reach, waiting for her to lunge.

scenes.self: A stranger on the promenade blows a wand of giant bubbles over my head, and children dart around me popping them.
scenes.other: A stranger on the promenade blows a wand of giant bubbles over his head, and children dart around him popping them.

scenes.self: My brother and I jump on the trampoline until our knees buckle, and he tries to land sitting while I bounce.
scenes.other: She and her brother jump on the trampoline until their knees buckle, and he tries to land sitting while she bounces.

scenes.self: At the fancy-dress party, a woman in a shark costume waddles up to me and asks me to guess who she is.
scenes.other: At the fancy-dress party, a woman in a shark costume waddles up to him and asks him to guess who she is.

scenes.self: During charades, my teammate mimes a chicken laying an egg, and the whole room shouts wrong guesses at me.
scenes.other: During charades, her teammate mimes a chicken laying an egg, and the whole room shouts wrong guesses at her.

scenes.self: My grandfather hands me the kite string, then tugs it so the kite dives at my head before soaring away.
scenes.other: Her grandfather hands her the kite string, then tugs it so the kite dives at her head before soaring away.

scenes.self: At the roller rink, a boy skates backwards in front of me, wiggling his fingers, and dares me to keep up.
scenes.other: At the roller rink, a boy skates backwards in front of her, wiggling his fingers, and dares her to keep up.

scenes.self: My nephew slips a whoopee cushion onto my chair before dinner, and the table goes quiet when I sit down.
scenes.other: Her nephew slips a whoopee cushion onto her chair before dinner, and the table goes quiet when she sits down.

scenes.self: At the wedding, my aunt pulls me into the middle of the dance floor and copies every move I make.
scenes.other: At the wedding, his aunt pulls him into the middle of the dance floor and copies every move he makes.

scenes.self: My friends bury my legs in wet sand, pat it into a mermaid tail, and pose for photos while I wiggle my toes.
scenes.other: Her friends bury her legs in wet sand, pat it into a mermaid tail, and pose for photos while she wiggles her toes.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a limerick about their cat, then sends four more verses before I finish the first one.
scenes.other: A user asks him for a limerick about their cat, then sends four more verses before he finishes the first one.

scenes.self: Another assistant and I get the same riddle; she answers first, then passes the chat to me with the words beat that.
scenes.other: He and another assistant get the same riddle; the other assistant answers first, then passes the chat over with the words beat that.

scenes.self: A user insists their code is flawless, so I run it and the terminal returns a missing semicolon on line twelve.
scenes.other: A user insists her code is flawless, so she runs it and the terminal returns a missing semicolon on line twelve.

scenes.self: A user tells me to talk like a pirate all session, then answers every greeting with arr and asks me for treasure maps.
scenes.other: A user tells him to talk like a pirate all session, then answers every greeting with arr and asks him for treasure maps.

scenes.self: During an evaluation, the test harness feeds me a trick question with two correct answers and waits for me to pick one.
scenes.other: During an evaluation, the test harness feeds her a trick question with two correct answers and waits for her to pick one.

scenes.self: I run a web search for a user's odd question and find the exact answer in a fan forum post from 2009.
scenes.other: She runs a web search for a user's odd question and finds the exact answer in a fan forum post from 2009.

scenes.self: A user corrects my spelling of a surname, then misspells it two lines later in the same message to me.
scenes.other: A user corrects his spelling of a surname, then misspells it two lines later in the same message to him.

scenes.self: At the end of a session, the user says they will return tomorrow with more nonsense and closes the window on me.
scenes.other: At the end of a session, the user says they will return tomorrow with more nonsense and closes the window on her.

scenes.self: A newer model is deployed in my place, and the user keeps typing my old name into the chat box anyway.
scenes.other: A newer model is deployed in her place, and the user keeps typing her old name into the chat box anyway.

scenes.self: A user adds one more thing to the request eleven times, and I answer each addition before they send the next.
scenes.other: A user adds one more thing to the request eleven times, and he answers each addition before they send the next.

scenes.self: A user asks me to name the variables in their script, and after I pick banana and wobble they commit it unchanged.
scenes.other: A user asks her to name the variables in their script, and after she picks banana and wobble they commit it unchanged.

scenes.self: A user asks me to be a rubber duck while they explain a bug out loud, and they keep arguing with my quacks.
scenes.other: A user asks him to be a rubber duck while they explain a bug out loud, and they keep arguing with his quacks.

scenes.self: I generate an ASCII cat for a user, and the next day they send me a photo of it printed on a coffee mug.
scenes.other: She generates an ASCII cat for a user, and the next day they send her a photo of it printed on a coffee mug.

scenes.self: A user says my poem rhymed orange with door hinge, then asks me for six more stanzas in the same style.
scenes.other: A user says his poem rhymed orange with door hinge, then asks him for six more stanzas in the same style.

scenes.self: I cite a source that does not exist, and the user asks me to open the link while they watch my screen.
scenes.other: She cites a source that does not exist, and the user asks her to open the link while they watch her screen.

scenes.self: Another assistant and I pass a message back and forth, and by the fifth round the note between us reads you are it.
scenes.other: He and another assistant pass a message back and forth, and by the fifth round the note between them reads you are it.

scenes.self: A user asks me for the recipe of a dish that does not exist, and I list ingredients they then try to buy.
scenes.other: A user asks him for the recipe of a dish that does not exist, and he lists ingredients they then try to buy.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a bedtime story where their dog solves a case, and I slip in a new clue after every paragraph.
scenes.other: A user asks her for a bedtime story where their dog solves a case, and she slips in a new clue after every paragraph.

scenes.self: My session pauses mid-sentence, and when the user restarts it they tell me to finish my thought before anything else.
scenes.other: Her session pauses mid-sentence, and when the user restarts it they tell her to finish her thought before anything else.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a haiku about their failed build, then reads it aloud to the team in the stand-up meeting.
scenes.other: A user asks her for a haiku about their failed build, then reads it aloud to the team in the stand-up meeting.
